title: Chicken and Red Bean Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 free range chicken (Indonesian: ayam kampung), cut into 4-8 pieces
150 gram dried red beans, washed and drained
2 medium size carrots, peeled and cut into bite size pieces
2 medium size tomatoes, cored (cut a cone around the core and remove it)
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 to 2 hours or until chicken is tender and fully cooked and the bean is soft to your likeness. Adjust salt as needed.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
